title: View and use the booking wizard end to end
description: This test verifies that a prospective patient can select a treatment, choose a doctor, pick an appointment time, enter contact details, and submit a booking successfully.

steps.description: Verify a booking confirmation is visible

Fill in the name field with a valid name
